page.overview:
Who is A'den?

A'den), designated CT-80/88-3009, was a senior clone commander in command of the 7th Legion, a division of the 327th Star Corps. "A'den" was a word in the Mando'a language that meant "rage" or "wrath." As a clone trooper, A'den was created on the planet Kamino from the clone template of the Human Jango Fett. The male clone trooper shared the template's tan skin and height of 1.83 meters.

A'den was first mentioned in the "Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic," an reference article in the eighty-fourth issue of Star Wars Insider, Named by author Karen Traviss, it was the same name given to Null-class Advanced Recon Commando Sergeant N-12. This is to set up how coincidental names are chosen by troopers in the Grand Army, such as troopers with the last digit in their call sign being five, the trooper may take the name "Fi".
